summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the concept of time, analyzing how people perceive and manage it in relation to personal goals and Torah living. Drawing on teachings from Pirke Abot, he discusses the balance between having a sense of urgency to accomplish mitzvos and avoiding the paralysis of feeling overwhelmed by too many tasks.
questions: Why do we always feel like we don't have enough time when we actually have many free hours in a week?
How does Rabbi Tarfon's teaching in Pirke Abot relate to our daily use of time?
What causes people to freeze when they have too many tasks, and how can we overcome it?
How should we balance a healthy sense of urgency with avoiding overwhelming anxiety?
